title: A fleet Live Activity push
description: The body the AgentPod hub sends APNs for a reader's fleet Live Activity (`apns-push-type: liveactivity`, topic `<bundle id>.push-type.liveactivity`): a push-to-start, an update or an end. One shape for the three, as AgentPod's zod `LiveActivityPushPayload` (packages/contract/src/fleet-live.ts) is, and as strict; `event` says which it is. A start carries `attributes-type`, `attributes`, `alert` and `stale-date`; an update carries `stale-date`; an end carries `dismissal-date`. Apple refuses a Live Activity payload over 4096 bytes of encoded JSON, a bound JSON Schema cannot state: the hub checks every push, and one over it sheds agent rows into `more`, then shortens the alert and the question, then drops the decision's options and last the decision, until it fits. The tokens it is sent to are registered through schemas/http/agentpod/live-activity.v1.openapi.json.

timestamp.description: Unix seconds. The hub keeps it moving forward for each reader.

attributes-type.description: The ActivityKit attributes type the app registers; a push-to-start names it.

attributes.description: The started activity's attributes: whose fleet it is.

stale-date.description: Unix seconds after which the app says the card is waiting for updates.

dismissal-date.description: Unix seconds at which an ended card leaves the Lock Screen.
